# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes go into the latest release.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue. Report vulnerabilities through [GitHub's private reporting](https://github.com/virtbase/virtbase-bookkeeping/security/advisories/new) or by email to support@virtbase.com.

We acknowledge reports within 48 hours and tell you the next steps.

## Scope

Bookkeeping runs locally and only listens on `127.0.0.1`. Reports about the following are especially welcome:

- API keys, the Monero view key or customer data leaving the computer
- Bypassing the local session checks from another website
- Tampering with the bundled Monero wallet binary or the update checks
